title: Harbour: resolveDisposition uses SD's 7-day record window (one exported copy)
description:
Repo: **JKershaw/LinearViewer (Harbour)**. Piece 4 of 4 of LIN-4164. **Lands only after piece 3 is merged *and deployed* on the SD host.** Landing earlier would show "Reply & continue" for sessions that SD still rejects with "No live session to resume".

## Slice of the approved plan

**Harbour:** `resolveDisposition` **uses SD's 7-day record window, with one exported copy.**

**Implemented as approved** (no deviations): PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2260](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2260>), squash-merged as `9e397e6`. `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` is now 7 d and exported from `lib/unanswered-decisions.js`; the test copies and "7h ago" fixtures import or derive from it. The full pre-prune description is preserved in the task snapshots, and the review/implementation history in the comment trail.

**Testing / done when:**

* The Harbour unit suite is green.
* A terminal loop 3 days old resolves to `resumable` ("Reply & continue"), and one older than 7 d resolves to `gone`.
* `grep -rnE "21600000|REAP_INACTIVITY|7 \* 60 \* 60 \* 1000" tests lib routes public` finds one definition in `lib/` and only imports elsewhere (apart from the out-of-scope heartbeat hits).
* Before merging, confirm on LIN-4164 that piece 3 is deployed.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4164's approving plan-review (comment 78e307fe-f83c-4eef-8358-9a0aacd5f9bc, rev 1)

**Grounding commits:** simple-dispatcher `cf6369d`, Harbour/LinearViewer `ff1f4aa5` (both origin/main; `git log --since=2026-11-03T17:14:22Z` on the touched paths was empty at breakdown time, 2026-11-03).

**Starting point:** the approved plan on the parent, **LIN-4164**, is where this piece starts. Read it in full there: the description's "Implementation Plan" section, the research comment (disk numbers, spike, class lists C1–C5), and the "Plan Review Verdict" comment (builder notes 1–7). Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4164.

parent.title: Keep finished sessions resumable for a week, not six hours

comments.body:
## LIN-4173 implemented: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2260

Harbour's `resolveDisposition` now uses SD's 7-day record window (`REAP_INACTIVITY_MS`, exported from `lib/unanswered-decisions.js`) instead of the private 6 h copy. The duplicate constant in the tests is gone; the tests import the one copy.

**Evidence**
- Branch `feat/lin-4173-harbour-record-window`, commit `99125f56`.
- Unit suite: 22,629 pass, 0 fail. Hermetic keyed run: PASS, no non-loopback sockets.
- Witness: with the constant back at 6 h, the new "3 days old -> resumable" test fails. Restored to 7 d.
- CI on PR #2260: all checks pass, including `CI success`.

**Not merged.** Merge must wait until LIN-4172 (SD split reap) is deployed on the SD host. Otherwise Harbour shows "Reply & continue" for sessions SD still rejects. Merge is for the orchestrator or a human after review.

## Autopilot evidence note (LIN-4164 run): LIN-4172 is deployed on the SD host

Checked directly, not from the tracker state:
* LIN-4172 PR #306 is squash-merged as `5379817` on simple-dispatcher `main`; CI `success` on that exact commit.
* The SD checkout (`/Users/autopilot/development/simple-dispatcher`) is at `5379817`, and the running dispatcher (`node dispatcher.js`, pid 90694) started at 2026-11-03 20:09:32, after the merge at 20:09:02. `config.js` on that commit has `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` = 7 d and `CLONE_REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` = 24 h.

So the precondition for this ticket's merge (SD keeps the record 7 d before Harbour offers "Reply & continue" for 7 d) is met. Review and close-out still decide whether this PR is approved and merged.

## Review — LIN-4173

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2260 at head `99125f5649f5854bc332662276deb04a91114a1c` (branch `feat/lin-4173-harbour-record-window`, 1 commit on `42fcf5d1`).

CI: green on head `99125f56`. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, secret scan and `CI success` all pass. PR is MERGEABLE.

**Scope matches the plan.** Four files changed, all of them named in the description: `lib/unanswered-decisions.js`, plus `unanswered-decisions`, `proxy-rulings-routes` and `dashboard-routes` tests. Nothing runs past the plan. `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` is now `export const … = 7 * 86400000`. That matches SD `config.js:587` (`REAP_INACTIVITY_DEFAULT_MS = 7 * 86400000`) at `5379817`. The comment correctly says why SD's 24 h `CLONE_REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` does not apply (LIN-4171 re-clones on resume).

**Done-when checks**
- Single definition: the description's grep finds one definition, at `lib/unanswered-decisions.js:54`. Everywhere else imports it. The remaining hits are the out-of-scope heartbeat/pulse windows (`digest-feedback.test.js:636`, `dashboard-routes.test.js:2536`, `live-console.js:67`, `common.js:153`) and unrelated 6 h fixtures. The test copy at `unanswered-decisions.test.js:13` is gone. The hand-written "7h ago" fixtures (`proxy-rulings-routes` ×2, `dashboard-routes` ×2) now derive from the constant, and so does the LIN-3959 `GONE` fixture at `:1230`.
- 3 days old → `resumable` with effect `resume`, and 8 days old → `gone`: both are covered by new tests in `resolveDisposition`.
- Unit suite: I re-ran the three touched route/unit files myself on `99125f56`: 473 pass, 0 fail.

**Mutation checks** (each reverted; the working tree is clean afterwards)
- M1: constant set back to 6 h (`21600000`). Only "terminal, 3 days old … → resumable" goes red (472/1). That pins the lower bound.
- M3: constant set to 30 d. "terminal, 8 days old … → gone" goes red, and so do the route `gone` fixtures. That pins the upper bound.
- M2: comparison changed to `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS * 100`, with the constant left alone. The route-level `gone` fixtures go red in `proxy-rulings-routes` and `dashboard-routes` (LIN-3260 cross-session, E1/E2, cold cache). The derived fixtures really are wired through `resolveDisposition`.
- The boundary tests at `:120/:126` (exactly at the window → resumable, 1 ms past → gone) import the constant. They pin the `<=` comparison, not the value, so M1 and M3 above are what pin the value.

**Regression check.** `git log` on the touched files shows nothing since this ticket was created (2026-11-03T18:04Z). The recent history (LIN-4114, LIN-4024, LIN-4003, LIN-3959, LIN-3602) does not touch the window or the `resolveDisposition` age branch. Nothing reverted is re-applied.

**Isolated, or one of a class?** It is isolated. The class is "Harbour code that decides whether an SD session record is still resumable". I searched `lib`, `routes`, `public`, `docs` and `public/llms.txt`:
- `public/*` only reads the server-sent `disposition`. `common.js:1224`, `chat.js:490`, `question-cards.js:341` and `observation.js:3654` recompute nothing.
- `lib/question-card.js:168` hard-codes `'resumable'` only for a *waiting* (`sessionWaiting:true`) session, which is never reaped. It is not an age decision.
- No docs state the 6 h window.

No unhandled sibling.

**Gating precondition: LIN-4172 deployed on the SD host.** I verified this myself rather than taking the LIN-4164 comment on trust:
- The host checkout `~/development/simple-dispatcher` is at `5379817` (LIN-4172).
- `dispatcher.js` (pid 90694) started `Tue 3 Nov 20:09:32 2026`.
- The process environment has no `REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` / `CLONE_REAP_INACTIVITY_MS` override, and there is none in `.env*`, so the 7 d default is live.

The merge gate in the description is therefore met.

No rulings exist for LIN-4173 (`count: 0`), and no `DECISION:` is raised.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **SD's live record window equals Harbour's copy (7 d).** *Inside* (a claim this change depends on; the description's "confirm piece 3 is deployed" gate). **Discharged:** verified above. The host is on `5379817`, the dispatcher restarted 20:09:32, and no env override is set. Cross-repo drift from a future SD change or env override stays tracked as LIN-2201 (outside, already filed). It is backstopped by SD's async `no-session` rejection.
- **End-to-end: "Reply & continue" on a real terminal session older than 24 h (clone already reaped) and under 7 d actually resumes on SD.** *Inside* (the ticket's user-visible outcome). CI cannot reach SD. **After the deploy:** once Harbour is live with this change, pick a terminal loop finished more than 24 h ago and less than 7 d ago. Confirm the card shows "Reply & continue". Reply, and confirm SD resumes the same session with a re-clone (LIN-4171 path) rather than answering "No live session to resume". The distinguishing precondition is age between 24 h and 7 d. Under 24 h, the clone still exists and the re-clone path is not exercised. A failed re-clone signal is LIN-4175 (outside, already filed).
- **Transitional mislabel for records SD already deleted under the old 6 h reaper.** *Inside* (a direct consequence of widening this window). Sessions that ended before about 2026-11-03 14:09 (6 h before the SD restart) and less than 7 d before "now" had their SD records deleted by the old reaper. After this merges, Harbour will label them `resumable`, and a reply gets SD's `no-session` rejection. The window clears itself by about 2026-11-10. **Named monitor:** SD's `no-session` rejection on a follow-up, the existing backstop that `lib/unanswered-decisions.js`'s comment already relies on. Only live traffic during that window can show it, and nothing needs fixing in code. Close-out should mention it in the merge note so a "No live session to resume" this week is not mistaken for a regression.
- **Rollback:** revert squash commit of PR #2260 (a code-only constant change; no persisted state in a new shape, since disposition is computed at press time and never stored).

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The change is complete, matches the plan's files and acceptance criteria, has mutation-verified tests on both bounds, and its merge gate (LIN-4172 deployed on the SD host) is verified as met. Close-out may merge PR #2260. It then runs the post-deploy 24 h–7 d resume check and records the transitional-mislabel note.

## Close-out — LIN-4173

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2260, squash-merged to `main` as `9e397e6` with `--match-head-commit 99125f56`. Harbour's `resolveDisposition` now uses SD's 7-day record window (`REAP_INACTIVITY_MS`, exported once from `lib/unanswered-decisions.js`).

**Final CI:** green on the exact merged head `99125f56`, read fresh just before the merge (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success`; MERGEABLE).

**Changes I made after approval:** none. Review asked for no fixes, so there is no unreviewed delta.

**Deploy:** Harbour's page footer shows `9e397e6`, so the deploy has landed (it still showed `42fcf5d` for about 8 minutes after the merge).

**Ledger**
- *SD's live record window equals Harbour's 7 d:* settled by review (SD host at `5379817`, dispatcher restarted 20:09:32, no env override). Cross-repo drift stays under LIN-2201 (outside, already filed).
- *End-to-end resume of a real terminal session aged 24 h–7 d:* **not run.** The only way to run it is to send a follow-up into a real finished session on an unrelated ticket, which starts an agent run there. I did not pick one on my own. Any operator can run it: open a terminal loop finished more than 24 h and less than 7 d ago, confirm "Reply & continue", reply, and confirm SD resumes with a re-clone rather than "No live session to resume". Under 24 h does not exercise the re-clone path. A failed re-clone signal is LIN-4175. Partial live evidence only (read-only, not a substitute): on the deployed Harbour, the `GET /rulings?includeResolved=true` row for LIN-4112 (answered 2026-11-02T07:35Z, about 37 h old, past the old 6 h window) reads `disposition: resumable`, `effect: resume`.
- *Transitional mislabel of records the old 6 h reaper already deleted:* sessions that ended before about 2026-11-03 14:09 and less than 7 d ago now read `resumable`, and a reply gets SD's `no-session` rejection. It clears itself by about 2026-11-10. Named monitor (from review): SD's `no-session` rejection on a follow-up. **A "No live session to resume" this week is this window, not a regression.**
- *Rollback:* revert squash commit `9e397e6` (code-only constant change; disposition is computed at press time and never stored).

**Related tickets:** LIN-4172 is already Done (its deploy was the merge gate). LIN-4175 (re-clone failure signal) and LIN-2201 (publishing SD's window cross-repo) already cover the outside items, so I filed nothing new. LIN-4164 stays open for its own close-out.

**Description:** archived (snapshot confirmed in `/issues/LIN-4173/snapshots`), then the files/approach block was replaced with an implemented-as-approved stub. Acceptance criteria, session-fit and plan-review lines were kept.
